text:
Elliot C: hey team :wave: i'm starting today and have a few quick security/setup Qs — hope this is the right thread.
1) my assigned security training is at 3pm but i have a customer call then, can i reschedule?
2) my new Mac says FileVault not enabled, is there an approved way to enable without breaking company key escrow?
3) do i need to request KMS access now for the dev sandbox or is that later? thanks!

Anita P: welcome Elliot :tada: — glad to have you. for training you can reschedule in the training portal (https://redwood.internal/training) or tell us preferred windows and we can move it. for Macs the flow is: enroll in MDM (Self Service -> Enroll Device) and the FileVault profile is pushed automatically. if that didn't happen, run `fdesetup status` and paste the output here. badge pickup is at Reception 2 (8:30–5pm) bring a photo ID.

Samir J: yo Elliot — cc'ing IT. if `fdesetup status` returns "Not Enabled" do NOT run sudo fdesetup yourself unless we ask. the preferred path is MDM-managed FileVault so the recovery key is escrowed. send me the device serial (or the top-right of About This Mac) and i'll push the profile.
If you must check quickly: `fdesetup status`
and for Windows it's `manage-bde -status C:`.

IT Bot: Ticket created: #IT-48291 for device enrollment push (owner: Samir J). ETA based on current queue: ~30–120 minutes.

Maya R: hi Elliot — quick on KMS/access: engineers do NOT get KMS by default. please open the KMS access request form (https://redwood.internal/sec/kms-request) and include a manager approval email. for short-lived sandbox creds we sometimes issue time-limited keys instead. also FYI: phishing simulation mailing is running this week — it will be a benign simulated phish and is part of baseline training. failures = training nudge, not disciplinary. if you're a contractor and need exemption, flag it with People Ops and security will review.

Elliot C: thanks all — serial is C02ZQ0ABC123. i picked a 10–11am window tomorrow for training if that helps. and understood on FileVault, i'll wait for the MDM push.

Samir J: got it, pushing enrollment profile now to serial C02ZQ0ABC123. will post when FileVault status flips. if it doesn't auto-enable within 2h i'll escalate to on-site tech.

Anita P: noted the training change to 10–11am tomorrow. welcome again — ping me directly if anything blocks your badge or laptop.

IT Bot: Ticket #IT-48291 updated: enrollment profile push started by Samir J.

Maya R: FYI Elliot — keep an eye out for a simulated phish email from "security@redwood-sim.local" in the next 48h. it's safe to report it to security or simply click the training report button if prompted.

Elliot C: thanks everyone :pray: — i'll report back once FileVault shows enabled.
